The '''Royal Slave Auction''' was held on [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] and headquarters of the [[Zygerrian Slave Empire/Legends|Zygerrian Slave Empire]].

==History==
Although the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrians]] were forced to disband the slave auction [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] due to [[Jedi–Zygerrian conflict/Legends|Jedi intervention]], [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Miraj Scintel/Legends|Miraj Scintel]] brought it back during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], in which she attempted to auction off the captured [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] population of [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]].
